plan.name: Keep closing commands in shortened comments
plan.summary: Change the shared factory post formatter so shortening a comment preserves its complete closing instructions, including command arguments and the ratification hash, for ratify, revise, choose, retry, stop and any other command it asks a person to comment. Reserve space for those instructions alongside the unchanged marker, byline and existing omission notice, still dropping collapsed details before clipping other body text within the existing size budget and keeping valid UTF-8. Posts that already fit, and shortening of posts without closing commands, keep their current output. Acceptance covers a plumbing proposal whose compressed test-source marker leaves less room than its test table needs, other closing commands, and unchanged short posts. Whoever merges records the previously unrecorded two-way decision to preserve closing instructions when shortening comments; SPEC.md and README.md remain accurate.

tests.name: TestClippedPlanKeepsRatificationInstructions
tests.says: A proposal whose marker leaves too little room for its acceptance-test table still displays its complete ratify instruction with the correct hash and its revise instruction, retains its marker and byline, and reports omitted detail; a short post stays byte-for-byte unchanged.

tests.name: TestClippedPostsKeepClosingCommands
tests.says: Shortening posts preserves complete choose, revise, retry and stop instructions, including multiple closing lines and instructions sharing a line with long prose, while retaining valid UTF-8, the marker, the omission notice, details-first reduction and the existing output for posts without commands.
